# --- Effective model resolution ---
model_identifier = "synthetic-review-summarizer-v1"

resolution = {
    "model": "synthetic-review-summarizer-v1",
    "engine": "openai-compatible-chat-completions",  # serving engine backing the model
    "adapter": "none",                               # no adapter/LoRA applied by default
    "effective_model": "synthetic-review-summarizer-v1",
}

# --- Capabilities and their defaults ---
capabilities = {
    "temperature": {"supported": True, "default": 0.7},
    "top_p":       {"supported": True, "default": 1.0},
    "max_tokens":  {"supported": True, "default": 256},
    "stop":        {"supported": True, "default": None},
}

# --- Build capability table ---
cap_df = pd.DataFrame(capabilities).T.reset_index()
cap_df.columns = ["capability", "supported", "default"]
cap_df["effective_default"] = cap_df["default"].apply(lambda v: "null" if v is None else v)

print("=== Effective Model Resolution ===")
print(pd.Series(resolution).to_string())
print("\n=== Capabilities & Defaults ===")
print(cap_df.to_string(index=False))"}
